case.summary: The evidence is not sufficient to decide on this risk score alert for card C05876-K2, at a fraud probability of 0.26 resting on 2 independent signal(s): $30.91 is low for this card (25% percentile); a fully specified device profile links 28 cards across 27 different customers inside a 14-day window; the profile appears on 49 cards book-wide, so it is a real link rather than a rare one. The activity fits account takeover: there is session-level evidence, but the device profile is shared across 27 different customers' cards, which is coordinated abuse across accounts rather than one account being taken over. No other documented pattern fits the evidence. The evidence points both ways, which is why the case goes to an analyst rather than being decided here (R8). Recommended actions: MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, CREATE_CASE, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST, with exposure of $30.91.
